module.title: Diffusion physics: viscosity, resistivity, thermal conduction, scalar diffusion, explicit and super-time-stepping
module.expensive_path: Parabolic flux evaluation for every diffusion operator each stage, and the RKL super-time-stepping loop that multiplies the number of parabolic sub-stages per hydro step.
module.rationale: Parabolic terms are a separate numerical problem (stencil, stability limit, STS scheduling) from the hyperbolic core, and upstream keeps a dedicated 10-test category for them.
excluded: Gravity, radiation and chemistry source terms live in their own modules
hazards: Decay-rate tests fit a rate from a time series; pass policy will likely be a rate window rather than pointwise
